body:
m1 review of 41e9591 (fresh-context adversarial pass on a clean worktree at the SHA, pin 0329c43): ACCEPT-WITH-NITS - one REQUIRED fix; the rule is implemented as approved and the foils are load-bearing.

REQUIRED (1): Unattached/Ambiguous masses collapse when the digression cluster wins target selection. induce.scala:403-417 keys otherAddr on assignment.cluster and targetAddr on the SELECTED cluster; when they coincide others.get is None and the competitor mass silently vanishes (dist drops the empty remainder and renormalizes). Scenario A (Unattached): "We ate at the restaurant. The year before we went to Montreal. The birthday cake had candles." - cluster 2 (Unattached) wins target (cueFit 1.0); the cake unit's address is Unresolved 1.0 while it is the SOLE unit of the materialized target episode; the restaurant unit becomes other0 0.8. The approved rule says Unattached opens an OtherSpecific cluster; here it becomes the target with zero target mass on itself. Scenario B (Ambiguous): "We ate at the restaurant. The year before we had the birthday cake in Montreal. We ate cake in Montreal." - cluster 1 wins target; the ambiguous unit gets Unresolved 0.571 / target 0.429 and cluster 0 (other0), which it is equally continuous with, gets 0. Minimal fix: address competitors by actual materialization - def addrOf(k) = if targetCluster.contains(k) then targetAddr else others.get(k).map(Episode(_, OtherSpecific)); Ambiguous = 0.4 Unresolved + 0.5*addrOf(0) + 0.5*addrOf(current); Unattached = 0.55 Unresolved + addrOf(current). Or exclude Unattached clusters from scored so "new OtherSpecific cluster" holds literally. Either way add scenario A as a foil.

NITS: (2) record honesty - induce.scala:224 records every unit while current == 0 as ContinuityStay although no continuity was evaluated (an opening "The dog barked in the park." before any target evidence gets target 0.89 with basis ContinuityStay; the board table maps ContinuityStay to OtherSpecific, here it also maps to target). Add PlacementBasis.Seed for cluster-0 default placement. (3) evidence - the placement basis and the matched marker span are not exported: ClusterAssignment is private, InductionResult carries no placements, ClaimMeta cites only the detail's own span (induce.scala:527-533), not the ReturnMarker span or the continuity partner unit. Address mass is the record per the board decision, but it is lossy (0.55/0.4 encode the basis by convention) - the vision asks that "which words support each conclusion" stay visible; a follow-up bead to export placement bases with marker/partner evidence is warranted. (4) rule-level, for the board - marker precedence has no negation / reported-speech guard: "We never went back to Montreal." and "She said anyway we should leave Montreal." both give ExplicitReturn, target 0.89, despite continuity with the digression. Only the CURRENT digression is consulted: "...Montreal. Another time we went to Paris. Then we walked around Montreal." is Unattached (other3), not a resumption of other1. ClusterContinuity ignores recall relations: in the fixture with "Then", "so I felt horribly embarrassed" lands in its own Unattached cluster (other3) separate from the waiter/cake unit (other2) despite the causal edge.

FIXTURE HONESTY: the fixture edit ("Anyway the waiter") is load-bearing and disclosed - restoring "Then the waiter" fails 4/16 BirthdayInterviewSuite tests (waiter + embarrassment become two Unattached clusters at Unresolved 0.55). Reverting the Unattached branch fails exactly "discontinuous with both ... not a silent target" (1/10), so the dog/park foil exercises it.

VERIFIED OK: determinism - 30 seeded shuffles of graph.units and details give identical addresses/target/otherEpisodes; ordering flows only through ordinal, sorted keys, and Distribution.mode name tiebreak; Ambiguous units excluded from byCluster as claimed. ClusterContinuity symmetric; "ANYWAY," matches, "Anyways" does not (closed list). No silent target from a digression: the only marker-free, continuity-free paths to target mass are the pre-digression seed (nit 2) and the pre-existing 0.12 spill in clusterAddress. No JVM-only API added.

COUNTS at 41e9591: scalafmtCheckAll clean; interviewJVM Passed: Total 40, Failed 0; interviewJS Passed: Total 40, Failed 0; fixturesJVM Passed: Total 96, Failed 0; compileAll (Native stage) still running, will append.
